B. Expericnce:
Applications are invited in Standard Format for I (one) number post of Procurement Expert to be engaged on
contraclual basis in Guwahati Municipal Corporation. Interested candidate may appear for the Walk In Interview
at the Office of the Commissioner, Guwahati Municipal Corporation, Betkuchi, Guwahati-781035 on
15/07/ 2026 at 10:00 AM along with the CV and relevant documents in original and photocopy.
A. A first-class Engineering graduate preferably in Civil Engineering with MBA or Master's degree/ Post
Graduate Diploma (minimum two years duration) in any discipline from any Govt.recognized
university/institution or Master's in Procurement/ Supply Chain Managemen/ Business Administration/Law or relevant subjects like Economics/ Accounting/ Finance. Candidates having advanced
academic/professional qualification in procurement will be given preference.
WALK IN INTERVIEW
Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in project procurement and contract
management.
C. Preferred skills include:
Experience in managing procurements funded by the World Bank/Externally Aided Project
(EAP),ADB, AIIB, JICA etc will be highly advantageous.
Ability to upload bids on GEM and Assam tenders
Proven experience in preparing procurement plans, Bid documents, preparing evaluation
reports and contracts as per Bank SBD and managing procurement processes Thorough
Knowledge of procurement through GEM and Assam tenders.
a) Good understanding of business processes
b) Good math skills
Thorough knowledge on GFR, Assam Public Procurement Act 2017 and Assam Public
Procurement Rule 2020, CVCGuideline, GEM.
c) Good negotiation, organizational and analytical skills.
d) Ability to work in a team environment.
D. Age: Between 25 years to 40 years as on 01/01/2026.
